summary.text: CIMPERIAL AS is a private limited company registered in Gran, founded 2014-02-17. CIMPERIAL AS operates cafe and restaurant business, as well as activities that are naturally connected to this. Its main industry code is 56.110: restaurant activities. The register shows 9 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 7 186 125 NOK and the annual result was 454 200 NOK; operating income was up from 6 766 435 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 119 216 NOK in 2024 to 454 200 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 883 183 NOK in 2024 to 1 337 382 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Yunxiang Cao (daglig leder and styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 13 on 2025-12-13 to 9 on 2026-10-14. Recent changes in the register: business address set to Smiegata 3 on 2026-11-05.
